requirement.statement: Codument SHALL use `decisions.xnl` as the default carrier for track and mission process decisions.

case.given: 用户创建一个需要过程决策或 DSL review 的 track
case.when: codument-plan-track 生成决策记录入口
case.then: 系统 SHALL create `decisions.xnl` rather than root `decisions.md`
case.and: 系统 SHALL put normal node properties in XNL `{}` attributes rather than metadata

case.then: 系统 SHALL represent parent-child decision relationships with nested XNL nodes

case.given: 一个新决策点需要用户在多个候选方案中选择
case.then: 系统 SHALL write exactly one <options> singleton under the decision's extend block
case.and: 系统 SHALL write repeated <option> nodes inside the <options> node's array block
系统 SHALL keep the decision's own array block reserved for nested child decisions
each option SHALL include a title and detailed description
exactly one option SHALL be marked recommended=true when a recommendation is available

case.given: 一个 decision 需要记录参与者回答以及回答后的整理信息
case.then: 系统 SHALL use exactly one <answer> container for answer feedback
case.and: 系统 SHALL write the original response as <raw-answer> under <answer>
系统 SHALL write <decision-text>, <rationale> and <evidence> under the same <answer>
系统 SHALL keep reading legacy direct <answer> text nodes

case.given: track 目录同时存在 `decisions.xnl` 与 legacy `decisions.md`
case.then: 系统 SHALL validate `decisions.xnl` as the canonical carrier
case.and: 系统 SHALL only use `decisions.md` as legacy fallback when `decisions.xnl` is absent

case.given: `decisions.xnl` 中存在 status="pending" 且 blocks 非空的 decision
case.then: 系统 SHALL report an error for the unresolved blocking decision

case.given: archived track 的 `decisions.xnl` 中存在 durable_candidate=true 且 status="accepted" 的 decision
case.then: 系统 SHALL be able to promote the durable decision to `codument/decisions/`
case.and: 系统 SHALL keep legacy `decisions.md` promotion readable for historical archives
